title: Open Weights, Closed Fists: OpenAI Ships a Keyboard While the Industry Fights Over Who Gets to See the Code
description: OpenAI enters hardware with the $230 Codex Micro keyboard, then does a stunning about-face by joining Nvidia, Microsoft, and 23 others urging Washington not to ban open-weight AI — even as it battles a rogue-agent scandal and an Apple lawsuit. Plus: Claude Opus 5 arrives cheaper and safer, and the hosts settle their scores on yesterday's predictions.
